note: Every site in src/ where text could be compared, cased, ordered or cut into words by something other than Unicode: toLowerCase/toUpperCase/toLocale*Case, localeCompare, Intl.Collator, normalize, SQL COLLATE NOCASE, LOWER(, UPPER(, GLOB (any case) and LIKE (capitals), and in regular expressions \b, \B, \w, \W, ASCII letter classes and the i flag on a RegExp built from data. scripts/test-text-comparisons.mjs holds each file's sites, per pattern, to these counts. Text a person writes (story, player, author, homebrew and workshop text, and searches) goes through the helpers in src/lib/language/text-logic.ts (textKey, words, containsPhrase, namesPattern, findNamed, compareNames, slugOf, asciiSlugOf), and stemmerWords in ./language.ts; a site classed human may stand only in the files under "humanTextIn". A new site is either one of those helpers or classified here with the reason it stays.

classes.human: text a person writes, compared only where "humanTextIn" allows
classes.key: ids, fixed choices, codes, paths, headers, protocol tokens and the engine's own vocabulary
classes.display: an initial or a label's case, shown, never compared
classes.rules: a fixed English vocabulary over SRD, content-pack or stat-block text
classes.story: a fixed English vocabulary over text people write: known, kept, listed to be replaced per reader
